id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

runStartTime.description:
The time that the {@link FaultySensor.Orchestrator} was kicked off. This time may not be related to the interval
of sensor updates that are being handled. See #fetchUpdatedSensorsStart and #fetchUpdatedSensorsEnd for that.

workflow.description: The created workflow that was triggered by the {@link FaultySensor.Orchestrator} to handle the #updatedSensors.

updatedSensors.description:
The list of sensors that were updated between #fetchUpdatedSensorsStart and #fetchUpdatedSensorsEnd. The status of
the sensors at the time this workflow ran can be found by looking at the {@link SensorOperationalStatusTimedValue}
at #runStartTime.

This field is expected to be populated, but not at creation time.

title:
Type to track the relevant information about the history of {@link FaultySensor.Orchestrator} runs to update
faulty sensors. Some uses of this type include:
- Tracking which [sensor updates](#updatedSensors) were handled in a #workflow. If a workflow
  fails, we can rerun the workflow on the same set of sensors.
- Knowing which sensor updates have been handled by a past run using #fetchUpdatedSensorsEnd. This allows the next
  run to pick up any new sensor updates that have not been handled.

@see FaultySensor
name: FaultySensor.Orchestrator.History
